annotation-review.title: Audit and correct annotations
annotation-review.description: Judge or correct an existing spatial or textual interpretation.

recognition.title: Recognize and classify
recognition.description: Assign identities or classes to supplied images, objects or candidates.

localization.title: Find and localize
localization.description: Search for a target and return its location or absence.

segmentation.title: Segment images
segmentation.description: Produce spatial labels for image elements or instances.

correspondence.title: Register and match
correspondence.description: Estimate poses, transformations or homologous points across observations.

geometry.title: Recover paths and topology
geometry.description: Repair connections, extract routes or construct geometric reformats.

motion-mechanics.title: Recover motion and mechanics
motion-mechanics.description: Recover time-dependent geometry or compute deformation and mechanics.

longitudinal-analysis.title: Track findings and change
longitudinal-analysis.description: Discover or associate findings across visits and characterize change.

reporting.title: Interpret and report
reporting.description: Produce evidence-qualified descriptions, answers or clinical interpretations.

quantification.title: Estimate physical quantities
quantification.description: Estimate physical parameters, fields, uncertainty or measurements.

image-reconstruction.title: Reconstruct images
image-reconstruction.description: Recover an image or object field from acquisition measurements.

image-restoration.title: Restore and synthesize images
image-restoration.description: Denoise, increase resolution or synthesize an image modality.

data-engineering.title: Decode and transform data
data-engineering.description: Preserve meaning while reorganizing, importing, resampling or converting data.

data-quality.title: Check data quality
data-quality.description: Detect inconsistencies or assess quality in supplied data.

prediction.title: Predict outcomes
prediction.description: Estimate a future or unobserved outcome from available observations.

eligibility.title: Apply eligibility criteria
eligibility.description: Match records to explicit inclusion and exclusion constraints.

workflow-operation.title: Operate an application
workflow-operation.description: Reach a requested application or tool state.
